projects.title: AskAAPM
projects.label: AskAAPM
projects.meta: First author · submitted to AAPM 2027 Spring Clinical Conference and JACMP
projects.summary: A retrieval-augmented system that answers questions about AAPM Task Group Reports and cites the source passages. Submitted to the AAPM 2027 Spring Clinical Conference and the Journal of Applied Clinical Medical Physics.
projects.short: Cited question answering over AAPM Task Group Reports.

built: A question-answering system for AAPM Task Group Reports.
Every answer cites the source passages it was based on.
steps: Task Group report PDFs are ingested
Reports are split into passages that can be searched
A question pulls back the most relevant passages
A short answer is written from those passages
The answer is shown with quoted evidence and citations
results: Submitted to the AAPM 2027 Spring Clinical Conference.
Submitted to the Journal of Applied Clinical Medical Physics.

projects.title: KinetIQ
projects.label: KinetIQ
projects.summary: An AI-assisted swing analyzer that tracks body and racket motion from video, then turns it into timing and consistency feedback for players and coaches. Submitted to the 2026 Congressional App Challenge.
projects.short: Swing analysis from video with computer vision.

media.alt: Screen recording of KinetIQ: a tennis serve video is uploaded and analyzed, then the results page shows a score, a pose overlay on the video, drills, and joint scores.
media.caption: Upload a tennis serve, run the analysis, and scroll through the results.

media.alt: KinetIQ results for a tennis serve: efficiency score 79, Intermediate, 345 frames analyzed, the player's video with a pose skeleton drawn over it, three recommended drills, and joint scores for trunk lean, right elbow, right shoulder, and right knee.
media.caption: Results for one serve: score, pose overlay, recommended drills, and a joint-by-joint comparison with a pro reference.

media.alt: KinetIQ upload screen with activity buttons for tennis forehand, tennis serve, golf swing, and golf putt, a drop zone for a video, and a Run button.
media.caption: Pick the activity, drop in a video, and run.

built: An upload screen for four activities: tennis forehand, tennis serve, golf swing, and golf putt.
Pose tracking drawn over the player's own video, so they can see what the analysis saw.
An efficiency score with a skill level, plus how many frames were analyzed.
A joint-by-joint comparison (trunk lean, elbow, shoulder, knee) that puts the player's angle next to a pro reference.
Recommended drills with sets and reps, with the top one marked for the player.
steps: Upload a video and pick the activity
Track the body's joints frame by frame
Compare them with a pro reference
Show a score, joint feedback, and drills
results: Submitted to the 2026 Congressional App Challenge.

projects.title: ChessAI Assistant
projects.label: ChessAI
projects.summary: Custom YOLO models and OpenCV read the board from Ray-Ban Meta camera feeds. Stockfish then suggests moves and explains tactics as the game unfolds.
projects.short: YOLO + OpenCV + Stockfish on smart-glasses video.

media.alt: Screen recording of ChessAI during an online game against a bot: every piece has a labeled box such as bR @ a8, the position is written out as a FEN string, and a suggested move such as f3d4 is shown for the side to move.
media.caption: Here ChessAI reads a Chess.com game through screen capture: it labels every piece, writes out the position, and suggests a move.

built: Custom YOLO models that find each piece and label it with its color, type, and square, such as bR @ a8 for the black rook on a8.
Board reading with OpenCV that turns the detected pieces into a full position, written as a FEN string.
Stockfish analysis that suggests the next move for the side to play and explains tactics as the game unfolds.
Two ways in: a camera pointed at a physical board (including Ray-Ban Meta camera feeds), or Chess.com through screen capture.
steps: Frames come in from a camera or the screen
YOLO finds and labels each piece
The position is written as FEN
